{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows and dtypes
print(df.head())
print(df.dtypes)
print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id: {(df['patient_id'].duplicated()).sum()}")

# Check the sample_seq distribution per patient_id
dup_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(dup_counts[dup_counts > 1])}")

# Check assay_batch values
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check if any biomarker_final values are suspiciously high (likely uncorrected batch B)
print(f"Max biomarker_final (raw): {df['biomarker_final'].max()}")"}
